title: Dil hai bechain shahe huda ka Ho raha hai safar karbala ka
body:
Dil hai bechain shahe huda ka
Ho Raha hai Safar karbala ka


<<DIVIDER>>


Maqsad hai wa'n se mulke baqaa ka
Ho Raha hai Safar karbala ka


<<DIVIDER>>


Bhai Abbas ye mashko Wale ,ao Pani tumhare hawale
Sath masoom bachcho ka hoga
Ho Raha hai Safar karbala ka


<<DIVIDER>>


Kahiyo beti tujhe kya khabar hai, raasta har qadam pur Qatar hai
Saamna ab hai dashte bala ka
Ho Raha hai Safar karbala ka


<<DIVIDER>>


Aaj hai bibiyo ko amaari , shaan se ja Rahi hai sawaari
Kal Kaha'n hoga Inka ye parda
Ho Raha hai Safar karbala ka


<<DIVIDER>>


Sab se ro roke kehte hai hazrat,ab yehi hai khuda ki masheehat
Mujhse chhut'ta hai Nana ka roza
Ho Raha hai Safar karbala ka


<<DIVIDER>>


Sath hai Bhai shabbar ka jaani , ek yehi hai Hassan ki nashaani
Zindagi me ye pamaal hoga
Ho Raha hai Safar karbala ka


<<DIVIDER>>


Sath tere Mera meh laqa hai, hum shabeehe rasoole khuda hai
Suwe maqtal chala hai ye fidya
Ho Raha hai Safar karbala ka
